In 4-dimensional [[geometry]], there are 15 [[uniform 4-polytope|uniform polytopes]] with H<sub>4</sub> symmetry. Two of these, the [[120-cell]] and [[600-cell]], are [[regular polytope|regular]].

== Visualizations ==
Each can be visualized as symmetric [[orthographic projection]]s in [[Coxeter plane]]s of the H<sub>4</sub> Coxeter group, and other subgroups.

The 3D picture are drawn as [[Schlegel diagram]] projections, centered on the cell at pos. 3, with a consistent orientation, and the 5 cells at position 0 are shown solid.

== Coordinates ==
The coordinates of uniform polytopes from the H<sub>4</sub> family are complicated.  The regular ones can be expressed in terms of the [[golden ratio]] {{nowrap|1=''φ'' = (1 + {{radic|5}})/2}} and {{nowrap|1=''σ'' = (3{{radic|5}} + 1)/2}}. Coxeter expressed them as 5-dimensional coordinates.<ref>Coxeter, ''Regular and Semi-Regular Polytopes II'', ''Four-dimensional polytopes'', p. 296–298</ref>

{| class=wikitable
! ''n''
! [[120-cell]]
! [[600-cell]]
|- valign=top
!valign=center|4D
|
The 600 vertices of the 120-cell include all [[permutation]]s of<ref>{{mathworld|title=120-cell|urlname=120-Cell}}</ref>
: (0, 0, ±2, ±2)
: (±1, ±1, ±1, ±{{radic|5}})
: (±''φ''<sup>−2</sup>, ±''φ'', ±''φ'', ±''φ'')
: (±''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, ±''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, ±''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, ±''φ''<sup>2</sup>)
and all [[even permutation]]s of
: (0, ±''φ''<sup>−2</sup>, ±1, ±''φ''<sup>2</sup>)
: (0, ±''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, ±''φ'', ±{{radic|5}})
: (±''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, ±1, ±''φ'', ±2)
|
The vertices of a 600-cell centered at the origin of 4-space, with edges of length 1/''φ'' (where ''φ'' = (1+{{radic|5}})/2 is the [[golden ratio]]), can be given as follows: 16 vertices of the form<ref>{{mathworld|title=600-cell|urlname=600-Cell}}</ref>
: {{sfrac|1|2}} (±1, ±1, ±1, ±1),
and 8 vertices obtained from
: (0, 0, 0, ±1) by permuting coordinates. 
The remaining 96 vertices are obtained by taking [[even permutation]]s of
: {{sfrac|1|2}} (±''φ'', ±1, ±1/''φ'', 0).
|- valign=top
!valign=center|5D
|
Zero-sum permutation:
: (30): {{radic|5}} (1, 1, 0, −1, −1)
: (10): ±(4, −1, −1, −1, −1)
: (40): ±(''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, ''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, ''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, 2, −''σ'')
: (40): ±(''φ'', ''φ'', ''φ'', −2, −(''σ''−1))
: (120): ±{{radic|5}} (''φ'', 0, 0, ''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, −1)
: (120): ±(2, 2, ''φ''<sup>−1</sup>{{radic|5}}, −''φ'', −3)
: (240): ±(''φ''<sup>2</sup>, 2''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, ''φ''<sup>−2</sup>, −1, −2''φ'')
|
Zero-sum permutation:
: (20): {{radic|5}} (1, 0, 0, 0, −1)
: (40): ±(''φ''<sup>2</sup>, ''φ''<sup>−2</sup>, −1, −1, −1)
: (60): ±(2, ''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, ''φ''<sup>−1</sup>, −''φ'', −''φ'')
|}
